coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review 'mongod' and 'unifi.sysusers' due to LLM API request failures (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent partial audits from resulting in inconclusive verdicts.
